_doc: Species (docs/CONTENT.md section 9), read by scripts/crew/crew_member.gd. A crew member's `species` (set by the ship design's `crew` list) sets their max hp (hp), walk speed (speed, a factor on the 3 cells/s base), traits (ids of the trait library, data/traits.json; merged with personal traits from data/crew.json and gear traits, see CrewMember.traits() and TraitSet.of), the art folder they are drawn with (rig: art/crew/<rig>/) and the hand weapon they carry (sidearm: an id of data/hand_weapons.json, drawn when idle in a fight). A species may also carry trait keys inline (work_mult on basalt), merged before its traits. What the keys do: data/traits.json `_doc`. default: the species of anyone whose design names none. The `traits` table that used to live here is still read for trait ids data/traits.json does not define.
